heading: Duration literals
text:
### Duration literals [LLEX.12.8]

Duration values are expressed as `time`-dimensioned `UNIT_LIT` values; the `_` sigil is
**optional** per LUNI.3.1, so `30s` and `30_s` produce the same token:

| Duration | Bare form | With sigil |
|---|---|---|
| 100 milliseconds | `100ms` | `100_ms` |
| 5 seconds | `5s` | `5_s` |
| 1 minute | `1min` (`m` is meters) | `1_min` |
| 2 hours | `2h` | `2_h` |
| 1 day | `1d` | `1_d` |

The bare suffixes `5s` / `100ms` / `2h` / `1d` are valid through the general
`UNIT_LIT` rule. A bare `m` is meters, never minutes: minutes are `min`.

Every construct that takes a duration accepts any
`time`-dimensioned `UNIT_LIT` value (parser-side check; non-time suffixes
emit `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_UNIT_DIMENSION`).
